package domain

import (
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

type TargetType string

const (
	TargetConcept    TargetType = "concept"
	TargetCapability TargetType = "capability"
)

var targetKeyPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:/-]{0,254}$`)

type TargetRef struct {
	Type    TargetType `json:"type"`
	Key     string     `json:"key"`
	Version string     `json:"version"`
}

func NormalizeTargetRef(input TargetRef) (TargetRef, error) {
	input.Key = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Key))
	input.Version = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Version))
	if (input.Type != TargetConcept && input.Type != TargetCapability) ||
		!targetKeyPattern.MatchString(input.Key) || input.Version == "" || len(input.Version) > 64 {
		return TargetRef{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func TargetIdentity(input TargetRef) string {
	return string(input.Type) + "\x00" + input.Key + "\x00" + input.Version
}

func NormalizeTargetRefs(inputs []TargetRef) ([]TargetRef, error) {
	result := make([]TargetRef, len(inputs))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(inputs))
	for index, input := range inputs {
		normalized, err := NormalizeTargetRef(input)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		identity := TargetIdentity(normalized)
		if _, duplicate := seen[identity]; duplicate {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		result[index] = normalized
	}
	return result, nil
}

func SortTargetRefs(inputs []TargetRef) []TargetRef {
	result := append([]TargetRef(nil), inputs...)
	sort.Slice(result, func(left, right int) bool {
		return TargetIdentity(result[left]) < TargetIdentity(result[right])
	})
	return result
}
